notes.title: The demo is back for good!
notes.notes:
Happy New Year everyone!

It's been some time since you heard about this project am I right? Well, a lot of things have changed since.

To sum it up, The project have been continued, then stopped, then completely overhauled! And then stopped again...

For the time being, we are putting this project aside. We've learn a lot with it and we will always feel attached to this project somehow. But we are moving on.

Yet the demo, you all loved is now available again, and this time for good! If you didn't have the time to try it back then or you want to redo the entire things, please do so. Have fun with it!

With love,
The Breakpoint Team

notes.title: Our demo is back!
notes.notes:
Greetings game changers,

Before going on holidays, we wanted to thanks your warm support by giving you access to the latest version of our demo.

Among the major changes:
- Correction of the English text that was breaking the flow for native speakers.
- Automatic text option for those who want to sail with the narration.
- Major fix: We added an input delay at the beginning of each gameplay phase so you don't accidentally submit an answer. 

With this you'll find a lot of small improvement on the general experience. 

We'll be glad to hear what you think of it, or our general work so far. We added a new channel dedicated on Vulnerable on our [url=https://discord.gg/W5q3AD2]discord[/url] server. Come say hi!

The Breakpoint Games team wishes you a merry Christmas, along with a warm and comforting end of year.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1919960/Vulnerable/

notes.title: One week to face your demons!
notes.notes:
Embody a displaced therapist in a futuristic refugee camp. Discover the life in the camp and share
your everyday life alongside people with heavy pasts. Use logic and your therapeutic skills to solve
mysteries threatening both your survival and the camp.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42198661/8a865d6f7d8bc09925ae9b0a91da8e739726b429.gif[/img]

The release date is aimed at 2023 but, this week, you have the opportunity to discover the first version of Vulnerable Demo!
